products.name: Frozen Chicken Seekh Kabab
products.tagline: Tender, juicy, charcoal-smoked minced chicken priced per dozen
products.description: Our signature Chicken Seekh Kababs are crafted from prime boneless chicken breast, finely minced with fresh ginger, garlic, green chilies, roasted cumin, and our secret family spice blend. Naturally blast-frozen within 30 minutes of preparation to lock in peak tenderness and smoky charcoal aroma.
products.storageInfo: Keep frozen at -18°C. Do not thaw before frying.
products.shelfLife: 6 Months from manufacture date in deep freezer.

steps: Heat 2-3 tablespoons of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Place frozen kababs directly into the pan without thawing.
Fry for 3-4 minutes, rotating every 60 seconds until all sides are golden brown and sizzling.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot with mint chutney.
cookingInstructions.tips: Do not thaw! Frying directly from frozen keeps the juices locked inside.

steps: Preheat air fryer to 180°C for 2 minutes.
Lightly brush or spray frozen kababs with oil.
Arrange in a single layer in the basket.
Air fry for 6 to 8 minutes, shaking basket at halfway mark.
cookingInstructions.tips: Great for a low-oil healthy meal option with crispy skin.

steps: Brush flat tawa with butter or ghee.
Sear kababs turning frequently for a rich tandoori crust.
cookingInstructions.tips: Sprinkle fresh chaat masala and lemon juice right before serving.

products.altText: Nimko & Kabab Co. frozen chicken seekh kabab dozen pack, ready to fry

products.name: Homestyle Chicken Shami Kabab
products.tagline: Velvety smooth shredded chicken and chana daal priced per dozen
products.description: Slow-cooked traditional Daal and Chicken Shami Kababs made just like grandma used to prepare. Silky texture, aromatic khara masala, and coated with a light whisked egg wash so they fry to a delicate golden crisp in minutes.

steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a shallow frying pan.
Place frozen shami kababs directly into medium hot oil.
Shallow fry each side for 1.5 minutes until crispy golden brown.
cookingInstructions.tips: Perfect for instant Bun Kabab sandwiches or quick daal-chawal dinner.

products.altText: Nimko & Kabab Co. homestyle chicken shami kabab dozen pack ready to fry

products.name: Gourmet Frozen Beef Seekh Kabab
products.tagline: Rich, melt-in-mouth prime beef with traditional Karachi spices (Per Dozen)
products.description: Crafted from premium quality prime beef mince infused with roasted papaya tenderizer, crushed black pepper, toasted coriander, and smoked mustard oil. Yields an authentic dhaba-style juicy texture that bursts with succulent flavors.
ingredients: 100% Halal Prime Beef Mince (80/20 lean to fat for juiciness)
Crushed Black Pepper & Red Chili Flakes
products.storageInfo: Keep frozen at -18°C. Do not re-freeze after defrosting.

steps: Add 2 tbsp oil or ghee to a hot skillet.
Fry frozen beef kababs for 4-5 minutes, turning every minute.
Let rest for 1 minute before biting for maximum juiciness.
cookingInstructions.tips: Serve with parathas, sliced purple onions, and tamarind imli chutney.

steps: Lightly oil the surface and air fry at 190°C for 8 minutes.
cookingInstructions.tips: Crisp exterior with ultra-tender center.

products.altText: Nimko & Kabab Co. frozen beef seekh kabab dozen pack, ready to fry

products.name: Spicy Beef Gola Kabab (Dumwale)
products.urduName: دم والے بیف گولہ کباب (درجن پیک)
products.tagline: Succulent round spiced beef dumplings with coal-infused smoke (Per Dozen)
products.description: Round, juicy and packed with a fiery kick of green chilies, mint, and kachri powder. These beef gola kababs are precooked on charcoal skewers and immediately blast-frozen, delivering sensational restaurant-quality barbecue in minutes at home.

steps: Toss into shallow hot oil or ghee.
Roll gently for 3-4 minutes until aromatic and browned.
cookingInstructions.tips: Garnish with freshly sliced ginger juliennes and lemon.

products.altText: Nimko & Kabab Co. spicy beef gola kabab dozen pack, ready to fry

products.name: Peshawari Chicken Chapli Kabab
products.tagline: Crispy edged, coarse ground chicken patties with pomegranate seeds (Per Dozen)
products.description: Authentic Khyber-style flat chapli kababs made with coarse ground chicken, crunchy pomegranate anardana seeds, roasted coriander crushed seeds, fresh diced tomatoes, and green chilies. Crispy edges with a tender juicy center.

steps: Heat oil in a flat skillet.
Fry each side for 2 minutes on medium heat until golden crisp.
cookingInstructions.tips: Serve with hot naan and green yogurt raita.

products.altText: Nimko & Kabab Co. Peshawari chicken chapli kabab dozen pack ready to fry

products.name: Royal Karachi Mix Nimko (Special Blend)
products.tagline: Crunchy golden chickpea sev, peanuts & lentils in 250g, 500g & 1000g packs
products.description: The crowning jewel of Karachi tea-time snacks! Prepared fresh in small batches using pure vegetable oil. Packed with crunchy gram flour sev, crispy spiced peanuts, fried green split peas, crunchy daal moth, and sprinkled with our hand-ground zesty chaat masala.
products.storageInfo: Store in an airtight container at room temperature away from direct sunlight.

steps: Ready to eat straight from the pack.
Optional tip: Warm in microwave for 15 seconds or toss on dry tawa for 30 seconds for an irresistible oven-fresh crunch!
cookingInstructions.tips: Pair with hot steaming Karak Chai or evening drinks.

products.altText: Nimko & Kabab Co. mix nimko pack in grams, crispy Karachi tea snack

products.description: For authentic lentil snack lovers. Light, airy, high-protein fried whole brown lentils and split moong daal seasoned with black Himalayan salt, amchoor powder, and freshly ground red chili.
products.storageInfo: Airtight container at dry room temperature.

steps: Tear open and enjoy immediately.
cookingInstructions.tips: Sprinkle over fresh dahi baray or fruit chaat for extra crunch!

products.altText: Nimko & Kabab Co. spicy daal moth nimko snack pack in grams
